subject: CAIQ customization & evidence bundle for Cedar Finance private deploy
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@cedarfinance.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cedarfinance.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ: Private deployment (VPC) control mapping and evidence request

Diego —

Thanks for the call earlier. As a quick follow-up, Cedar needs a CAIQ mapping that clearly explains how Redwood's private deployment (VPC + customer-managed KMS) satisfies the CSA control objectives. Two things we're trying to validate for our security board this quarter:

1) Tenant isolation guarantees and evidence for multi-tenant runtime (we'll need a short design diagram + sample runtime logs showing tenant-id segregation).
2) Key management and HSM/KMS usage: attestations, rotation cadence, and any support for customer-supplied keys.

Could you provide a consolidated CAIQ response package that:
- Maps our scoped controls to Redwood's control statements (CSV or spreadsheet preferred)
- Includes representative artifacts (redacted logs, diagram, key rotation policy PDF)
- States any exception or compensating control for controls you don't fully cover

We're aiming to present to our security board on Nov 23. Ideally we'd get the package by Nov 17 so our InfoSec can review. If there are any small formalities (NDA/addendum) that need to be signed before you share logs, flag them.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Security Engineering, Cedar Finance
[Attachment: cedar_scope.pdf (pdf, 22KB)]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ: Private deployment (VPC) control mapping and evidence request

Kim / Priya — forwarding a Cedar ask. They need a CAIQ mapping and a small evidence bundle for a private (VPC) deployment: tenant isolation diagram, sample runtime logs demonstrating tenant-id separation, and KMS/HSM rotation docs. Cedar wants the package by Nov 17 so they can prep for a Nov 23 security board.

Please own the mapping spreadsheet (CSV) and the list of artifacts. Suggested deliverables:
- caid_map_v1.xlsx: control -> Redwood statement -> evidence pointer -> exception/compensating note
- runtime_log_samples.zip: 3 redacted request/response traces showing tenant-id header separation (timestamps, request-id).
- tenant_isolation_diagram.png: simplified network diagram for private deploy.
- short cover note (1 page) summarizing which controls require additional legal attestation.

Kim: can you take lead on the mapping and evidence checklist? Priya: please confirm whether we need an NDA/DocuSign addendum to share the redacted logs; if so, route to legal and I'll sign off.

Tagging due dates: draft mapping by EOD Nov 15, final package by Nov 17. If this timeline is impossible, propose a schedule and minimal set we can share quickly.

Thanks —
Diego
Head of Solutions Engineering
[Forwarded attachment: cedar_scope.pdf]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: CAIQ: Private deployment (VPC) control mapping and evidence request

Diego / Priya —

Attached is the initial mapping and artifact list. Highlights and notes below:

- caid_map_v1.xlsx (attached): 78 control rows; I've populated Redwood's short-form responses and pointed to the primary artifacts. Columns: Control ID | Control Objective | Redwood Response (short) | Evidence pointer | Evidence type | Exception/Notes.

- Key areas that require explicit attestation or legal sign-off:
  * CC-KE-2 (Key lifecycle): we have rotation policy + KMS audit logs but Cedar is asking for evidence tied to customer-supplied keys in their VPC; for BYOK we need the Private deployment KMS-runbook + attestation from infra.
  * ID-TIA (Tenant isolation): design diagram attached; sample traces included in runtime_log_samples.zip. The traces are redacted and stamped with internal witness lines.

- Attachments included in this draft: caid_map_v1.xlsx, runtime_log_samples.zip, tenant_isolation_diagram.png.
- I've added a short one-page cover (first sheet in the XLSX) that maps the top 10 controls Cedar flagged and states whether we provide direct evidence or compensating controls.

Action items:
- Priya: confirm whether we need the legal addendum before sharing the zip (redacted logs). If yes, do we propose a one-page Data Exchange Addendum (DEA) or a full NDA?
- Diego: if you agree with the messaging in the cover page, I'll prepare the final package and a short email to Cedar asking them to sign DocuSign for the logs.

Kim
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: caid_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 62KB); runtime_log_samples.zip (zip, 420KB); tenant_isolation_diagram.png (png, 180KB)]
